body: A road is rubbed out on the map, while six small figures remain beside it. The pencil has worn through the paper at the place where they waited. The string has been retied since morning.
title: The count beneath the route at closing

body: The board lists four vehicle numbers and no names. An erased fifth line still bears the pressure of a child’s small handwriting. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: A tally without passengers at closing

body: The sealed kit is tied to a towel marked for a passenger. The seat allocation has been crossed off, though the towel is still damp. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: Supplies for an empty seat at closing

body: The loose page gives a route at odds with the one inked on the map. Someone has traced both with a finger stained from a lunch wrapper. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: Two directions in one fold at closing

body: The battery is taped to a torch beside a handwritten departure time. Its owner waited long enough to use up the spare. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: The lamp after closing at closing

body: A badge and a band for counting arrivals are tied together. The band has an extra notch that never made it onto the badge. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: An unissued place in line at closing

body: The jack bears fresh road grit and the wrench a strip of warning tape. The repair was abandoned beside a penciled clearance time. The string has been retied since morning.
title: Repair before the barrier at closing

body: A frequency is scratched into the pencil’s paint. The radio’s own label names another channel, and the paper wrapped around it says to wait. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: The second signal at closing

body: A penciled household count ends at six. A red pen adds one name in the margin and then runs out before the line for a seat. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: One more household at closing

body: The bag contains an unused lunch wrapper; the map is folded to a stop crossed out twice. A child wrote the original time on the strap. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: Packed for the wrong stop at closing
